scope: Every native helper call and write runs. Separate verification-only C decodes every original loop/helper instruction, calibrated against the independent Python executor. Prefix/suffix full-state and final 16 MiB RAM/8 MiB VRAM comparisons remain. Ordered inner calls/writes use streaming fingerprints plus exact counts, endpoints and invariants; fingerprints alone are not collision-free proofs. No physical DMA, IRQ timing or pixels are established.
